generatedFrom.title: Account testing, patient
generatedFrom.narrative: One or two attempts per card, spread over an hour, deliberately slow enough to stay under any fixed threshold.
generatedFrom.correlation: A small number of sessions, a large number of distinct cards, and an approval rate no honest traffic reaches.
generatedFrom.recommendedAction: Contain it, but expect to need a longer window than a burst detector uses.
generatedFrom.difficulty: Never exceeds a per-minute threshold at any point. The signal is the approval rate and the card-to-session ratio, both of which need a window long enough to see them.
